mg_seedlings_for_the_sanctuary.description: I grow seedlings from the glade's oldest trees, and the Emerald Reclamation in Felwood has asked for them. They want to plant them where the fel has been burned away. Moonglade's soil is the cleanest in Kalimdor, and the Sanctuary needs every bit of it. I've packed a tray, and it needs carrying carefully. Will you take it down for me?
mg_seedlings_for_the_sanctuary.accept_text: Fly down to the Emerald Sanctuary in South Felwood and give the tray to Arch Druid Aelyra Moonbough. Keep them away from Felwood's water.

mg_something_to_grow.description: My grandmother grew chillies on a balcony in Chengdu, and I plant things in the Wakened's gardens because it's how I know where I am. The druids grow everything here without any help from me. I want something that's mine. I'd like a bed of Golden Sansam, which grows wild in the high places and nowhere in the glade. If you bring me some with the roots on, I'll do the rest.
mg_something_to_grow.accept_text: Golden Sansam grows in Felwood, Azshara and the high passes. Pick it with the roots on, and wrap it in damp moss.

mg_the_black_gate.description: Behind the Black Gate of Jaedenar, the Shadow Council keeps a demon chained. Zar'gothrax the Unbound has been pulling at those chains since the worlds came together. The Circle has felt every pull in the roots of the glade, and so have I. I want the demon dead. I've waited three years for someone who could do it.
mg_the_black_gate.accept_text: Jaedenar's in the north-west of North Felwood, behind the Black Gate. Zar'gothrax is at the very bottom, so take friends you trust.

mg_the_fish_are_turning.description: I've fished Lake Elune'ara my whole life, and the fish have started turning toward the island at night. All of them turn, the way a field of flowers turns to the sun. My mother fished this lake, and her mother before her, and neither of them ever saw it. I want someone else to see it, so I know I'm not imagining it. The falls are where the water's clearest.
mg_the_fish_are_turning.accept_text: The Falls of Elune'ara come down on the north shore. Stand where the spray settles and look into the water.

mg_the_same_dream.description: I keep a book for my guests to write in, and for the last month half of them have written down the same dream. It's a door under water, and a stair going down. These are people who've never met, writing the same thing in their own words. I want Dr. Sandvik to see it, because she's the only one in the glade who collects dreams on purpose. Take it round the lake to her for me.
mg_the_same_dream.accept_text: It's all in the back half of the book. Take it round the lake to the doctor, she'll want it more than I do.

mg_the_thunder_bluff_road.description: I flew the Thunder Bluff road for twenty years before it fell. Elder Longtread at Camp Taurajo keeps the seat for Cairne Bloodhoof, and I've never been able to bring myself to fly him the list of who reached Moonglade. Archdruid Hamuul has written it out, every name. Someone has to carry it, and I can't. Will you take it to him for me?
mg_the_thunder_bluff_road.accept_text: Camp Taurajo's in the Southern Barrens. Give Longtread the list, and tell him we looked, and that's everyone.

mg_the_totems_on_our_backs.description: When Thunder Bluff fell, those of us who reached Moonglade carried our lodges' totems up the mountain on our backs. I've kept them laid down ever since. The survivors built a memorial, and we've argued about it for three years. I'd like someone who wasn't there to stand at it and tell me what it looks like to a stranger. Tell me honestly whether it looks like a grave or a promise.
mg_the_totems_on_our_backs.accept_text: The memorial's a short walk south-east of here, by the lodges, a cairn with feathers on it. Look at it properly, then come back.

mg_the_well_runs_over.description: Every night the great moonwell runs over by a finger's width, and every morning it's settled again. I've been writing down the times, and they match something on the lake. I can't watch both at once. I want someone at the end of the pier to watch the island while I watch the well. When the well rises, I'll know, and I think you'll know too.
mg_the_well_runs_over.accept_text: Go to the end of Nighthaven's pier and watch the island in the middle of the lake. Come back and tell me what you saw.

mg_what_dies_in_deadwind.description: I can walk the Emerald Dream to almost anywhere in Azeroth. Since the worlds came together there's one place I can't reach, and that's Deadwind Pass. I want to know what's happening to the living things there. The deer of the pass will tell me, if you bring me what's left of them. The bone remembers what the animal dreamed, and I'll read it.
mg_what_dies_in_deadwind.accept_text: The Dissolving Stags wander Deadwind West, coming apart a little more every day. Bring me their antlers.

mg_who_are_they_talking_to.description: I guard the Barrow Dens' door, and I've heard the sleepers inside answering someone. They aren't talking to each other, I'm sure of it. They're talking to someone else. I need a witness who isn't a warden, because the Circle will say a warden was only frightened. Stand at the door with me and listen, nothing more.
mg_who_are_they_talking_to.accept_text: Don't touch the thorns. If you hear it, you'll know, because it's the only voice in there that doesn't sound asleep.
